item.text: [{"task_id":"95755ff2","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    frame = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    required = int(round(params['geometry'][0]))","    unit = int(round(params['geometry'][1]))","    out = grid.copy()","    h, w = grid.shape","    if bg == frame or required < 2 or unit != 1:","        return out","    inside = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=bool)","    for r in range(h):","        cols = np.where(grid[r] == frame)[0]","        if len(cols) == required:","            left = int(cols[0])","            right = int(cols[-1])","            inside[r, left + unit:right] = True","    for vector in params['directions']:","        dr = int(round(vector[0]))","        dc = int(round(vector[1]))","        if abs(dr) + abs(dc) != unit:","            return grid.copy()","        count = w if dr != 0 else h","        for k in range(count):","            if dr != 0:","                r = 0 if dr > 0 else h - unit","                c = k","            else:","                r = k","                c = 0 if dc > 0 else w - unit","            color = int(grid[r, c])","            if color == bg or color == frame:","                continue","            r += dr","            c += dc","            while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:","                if inside[r, c]:","                    if grid[r, c] != bg:","                        break","                    out[r, c] = color","                r += dr","                c += dc","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[2],"geometry":[2],"directions":[4,2]},"params":{"colors":[0,2],"geometry":[2,1],"directions":[[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]},"rationale":"Boundary colors project straight inward through the diamond's interior. Each projection stops at its first existing interior object. The red outline and exterior remain unchanged.
